_doc: Slice 4a parity follow-up (Ruling DV): the window's SettingsView.parseInput and qbt's pref-set must refuse exactly the same announce_ip, web_ui_username and path-cleanliness inputs, with the same message. qbt is the source of truth these cases were derived from (PREF_CAST_JQ's ipv4/ipv6/clean_path defs and the announce_ip/web_ui_username text-type branch). Read by tests/test_prefs.py (against the real qbt) and by a node test for SettingsView.parseInput. Every case is {key, input, ok, message?, why}; message is present only when ok is false, and is qbt's exact sentence; why is a short human note for a failed assertion's label. The path cases use save_path as their key.
